message: My question is that my husband is in prison in Maryland.  He has a prepaid account within the prison, however it does not work.  T-netix has taken about 100 out of his account (at my husbands request) back in June and July, however it is not showing up on his account with )-netix.  My husband sent me his Inmate Banking Form and its on there that they took the money out.  So,  I called T-netix they said they can't help me because they have no idea what I am talking about they never heard of a prepaid account in prison.  I then called Correctional Billing services they have no idea either. I need to know if anyone has any clue what I can do about this.  Also, the prison keeps referring me to T-netix.  Please help I have not been able to talk to my husband on the phone for 2 1/2 months.  Thank you !!!!
